newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 19.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchages resume trading in shares of four firms suspended on Friday afternoon but said initial invistigations had found irregularities and further probes will continue.
- Commentary says the suspension of trading in the four firms' shares signals the securities authorities and exchanges will take tougher measures to deal with irregularities in stock trading.

- BUSINESS NEWS - China television makers have launched a new price-cutting round since March but experts believe lowering prices is not the right way to develop the nation's television industry, it should be done through improving quality.
